findings.title: Security (surface 5): injection
findings.body:
Reachability: Feishu event field `event.message.content` is decoded at service/feishu_finance_agent.go:319 (`common.UnmarshalJsonStr(msg.Content, &content)`) into `text` (line 320) and persisted as `action.RawText`; `runFeishuFinanceAgentAction` re-reads it at service/feishu_finance_agent.go:350 and passes it to `parseFeishuFinanceAgentCommand(ctx, text)` at line 359, which enters `parseFeishuFinanceAgentCommandLLM` and is placed verbatim as the `user` chat message at service/feishu_finance_agent_client.go:287; the messages slice is then POSTed to the model endpoint at service/feishu_finance_agent_client.go:350. The model's JSON answer (intent/target_account/commission/gift_credits) directly drives privileged writes in `executeFeishuFinanceAgentPlan` (`AddAffPromotionUsers`, `GrantAdminCredits`).
Note: Untrusted natural-language message content (any Feishu user who can reach the bot, or third-party text an operator pastes) is fed into the LLM parser as instructions; there is no delimiter/role separation between data and instructions. Mitigations present: deterministic numeric bounds and defaulting in `buildFeishuFinanceAgentPlan`, live Root re-authorization, originator-only confirmation, injection-hint warnings, and buttons carrying only a server-side action id. These constrain the blast radius but do not remove the influence of attacker-controlled text on the privileged action the operator later confirms.
findings.recommendation: Fix the issue, or provide evidence that the path is not reachable.

findings.title: Security (surface 7): SSRF
findings.body:
Reachability: Env var `FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_OPENAPI_BASE` read at setting/feishu_finance_agent_setting.go:32 -> `cfg.OpenAPIBase` -> `feishuFinanceAgentWSDomain` at service/feishu_finance_agent_ws.go:101 -> `larkws.WithDomain` at service/feishu_finance_agent_ws.go:102 -> `client.Start` at service/feishu_finance_agent_ws.go:106 opens an outbound WebSocket to the derived host.
Note: The outbound WebSocket host is derived from the deployment env var `FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_OPENAPI_BASE`; `feishuFinanceAgentWSDomain` only trims a trailing slash and `/open-apis`, so any host/scheme in that env value is accepted. An attacker who can set or influence that env value can redirect the SDK's outbound long connection to an arbitrary host. This is config-controlled rather than a remote request field, but the source-to-sink path is concrete.
findings.recommendation: Fix the issue, or provide evidence that the path is not reachable.

findings.title: Structural drift: ownership
findings.body:
Standard: AGENTS.md#architecture
Note: The service layer imports gorm.io/gorm and branches on gorm.ErrRecordNotFound, making business logic depend on the model layer's ORM error instead of a model-layer domain error; this crosses the documented Service -> Model ownership boundary.
findings.recommendation: Align placement / naming / ownership with AGENTS.md#architecture.
